ROUND 2 security PASS for PR #259 at 65d00078ba93664b1854d768d8531dcd0e2542f4.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerabilities found | - |

The security-review specialist reviewed the R1-to-R2 security delta, excluding inherited rebase-only #257 changes, and found no introduced vulnerability. The late-stderr delay/split preload is test-parent-only: it is not propagated to the extension child or installed SDK, and the normal recipe never loads it. Barrier events and facts stay JSON over private stdio, without a new shell, module or code-injection path. No new public fixture/docs/JSON secret or prohibited private/home-path disclosure was found.

Child environment inheritance is unchanged from R1: ambient credentials, NODE_OPTIONS and test flags remain inherited. This relies on C33 trusted same-user environment, not credential sandboxing. The normal canary keeps temporary isolation, cleared seat/tmux identity and the overridden daemon address. No outstanding R1 security finding existed; no new normal-use security blocker or C34 hardening follow-up is raised. Reviewer/performance closure of R259-001 and R259-002 remains in those roles.

Validation: exact detached HEAD verified clean; just pr-freeze 259 returned FINAL, with remote/GitHub agreement, main base, CLEAN, ready, unchanged migration numbering and passing CI check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test and Delivers. just copilot-sdk-contract exited 0 with all seven checks passing on installed Copilot 1.0.114-0. The just recipe was invoked without an outer nice, per the updated instruction. --record was not used. target/ was absent before and after and git status stayed clean. No builds, cargo commands or dependency installations were run.

Known limits: static security inspection plus the normal real-SDK canary; security did not rerun the delayed-stderr regression/mutation suites or trace credential-file access.
